svg.text: Waveform Timing Comparison: Write Policies & Hit/Miss Latencies
Measured cycle costs at memory latency L=4 (includes 1 cycle CPU acceptance handoff)

g.text: FSM Path: S_IDLE (1 cyc) → S_COMPARE (1 cyc) → S_WRITE (5 cycs) → S_RESPOND (1 cyc)
Action: Updates cache word at index and simultaneously issues write-through to main memory (latency 4 + 1 ready pulse).
2. Write Miss under No-Write-Allocate (WRITE_ALLOCATE = 0) — 8 Cycles Total
FSM Path: S_IDLE (1 cyc) → S_COMPARE (1 cyc) → S_WRITE (5 cycs) → S_RESPOND (1 cyc)
Action: Bypasses cache allocation completely. Directly performs write-through to memory. Preserves victim cache line.
3. Write Miss under Write-Allocate (WRITE_ALLOCATE = 1) — 28 Cycles Total
FSM Path: S_IDLE (1 cyc) → S_COMPARE (1 cyc) → S_ALLOCATE (20 cycs) → S_WRITE (5 cycs) → S_RESPOND (1 cyc)
Action: Fetches full 4-word block into cache; overlays written word during beat reception; commits tag/valid; then performs write-through.
Mathematical Breakdown: 3 (FSM overhead) + 4 words × (4 + 1) [refill] + 1 word × (4 + 1) [write-through] = 28 cycles.
